purpose: Give the experiment-83 reranker design a stable estimate by rotating the held fold four times. Experiment 83 trained on folds 1-3 and evaluated only fold 4, where mice2 gained +0.05 while mice1 gained +0.48.

design.base: identical to experiment 83: production-style three-branch Task 3 score (MLP hidden 1024 10 epochs seed 42, encoding prototypes, softmax-DCT continuous), equal row-z
design.cross_fitting: for each held fold k in 1..4: reranker trained only on OOF rows of the other three folds, applied to fold k; every fold therefore serves once as an untouched evaluation fold
design.hyperparameter_source: unchanged from experiments 83 and the Task 2 production reranker; no tuning

metrics.ocf: official OCF per fold, RNG123 heldout pictures [256:768], aggregated as the mean of the four fold means and separately per mouse x session
metrics.top1: held argmax accuracy, aggregated the same way

pass_rule.advance: aggregated fold-mean OCF gain over base is at least +0.30 for BOTH mice, at least 5 of 8 mouse x session groups show a non-negative aggregated gain, and aggregated top1 is not lower for either mouse
pass_rule.otherwise: the Task 3 reranker route is closed

prohibited: using a fold's own rows to train the reranker that scores it
